full_details.title: Interactive Tablet Ebook Development
full_details.full_description:
I have all core assets—final text, illustrations, audio tracks and several short animations—ready to be assembled into a single interactive ebook aimed at iPads and other modern tablets. Your task is to weave everything together so the reading experience feels native: page-wide transition effects, touch-triggered animations, synced audio playback and smooth navigation throughout the title.

The finished file should run flawlessly in Apple Books on iPad and the main Android tablet readers that support EPUB 3 (or an equally capable format you propose). I’m happy to hear your approach, but HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript inside a fixed-layout EPUB is what I have in mind.

Needed within one month, so please take on the project only if you can meet that window and demonstrate you have the skills to deliver.

Deliverables  
• A production-ready, tablet-tested interactive ebook file (EPUB 3 or agreed format)  
• All associated source files for future updates  
• Brief hand-off notes explaining how to update content or re-export  

To confirm your ability, share a concise example—video, link or build—that shows comparable interactive elements working on a tablet. If it proves you can replicate the page effects and user-driven animations described above, we can get started right away.
